description_en: Call the ListVpcEndpointZones operation to query the zones of an endpoint
description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointZones接口，查询终端节点可用区列表
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink list-vpc-endpoint-zones --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-id ep-hp33b2e43fays7s80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListVpcEndpointZones

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

If this is your first query, you do not need to specify this parameter.

If a next page exists, set the value to the NextToken value that is returned from the previous call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~1000，默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the endpoint.

After you specify the endpoint ID, the system queries the zones of the endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
要查询可用区的终端节点ID。

指定终端节点ID后，系统会查询该终端节点的可用区
parameters.name: endpoint_id

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

If this parameter is empty, no next page exists.

If a value is returned, use the value to retrieve the next page of results
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

EniId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint ENI

EniIp.description_en: The IP address of the endpoint ENI

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the endpoint is deployed

VSwitchId.description_en: The vSwitch in the zone. The system automatically creates an endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) in the vSwitch
VSwitchId.description_zh: 可用区中的交换机，系统会自动在该交换机下创建一个终端节点网卡

ZoneDomain.description_en:
The domain name of the zone.

After an endpoint connection is established, use this domain name to access the service resources of the endpoint service
ZoneDomain.description_zh:
可用区域名。

终端节点连接建立成功后，可以通过该可用区域名访问终端节点服务中的服务资源

ZoneIpv6Address.description_en: The IPv6 address of the endpoint ENI

ZoneStatus.description_en:
The status of the zone. Valid values:

Creating: The zone is being created.

Wait: The zone is waiting to be connected.

Connected: The zone is connected.

Deleting: The zone is being deleted.

Disconnecting: The zone is being disconnected.

Disconnected: The zone is disconnected.

Connecting: The zone is being connected
ZoneStatus.description_zh:
可用区状态，取值：

Creating：创建中。
Wait：等待连接。
Connected：已连接。
Deleting：删除中。
Disconnecting：断开连接中。
Disconnected：已断开。
Connecting：连接中
